summary: UWM Holdings filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a resale registration covering up to 1,500,000 Series A-1 Preferred shares, 165,000,000 Class A Warrants at $6.00 per share, 165,000,000 Class B Warrants at $2.00 per share, and 330,000,000 Class A Common shares issuable on exercise. The securities trace to an August 5, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with Oaktree-affiliated funds, SFS Holding Corp., Mat Ishbia, and SFS Group Capital. Greenberg Traurig's opinion was filed as Exhibit 5.1. The structural note is significant investor overhang; watch warrant exercise dynamics and any resale pressure on UWMC shares.
